thread:
Anna (eng-platform): quick sync: Zoe demoed the decision card prototype. need to agree on sampling defaults and what the sim shows before we ship.
Zoe (devex): demo recording here: https://playback/sim/dec-card. My card shows: time, trigger metric snapshot, reason code, sample gallery (3 diffs), and a small "rollback" CTA.
Maya (product): looks good. two product asks: 1) a clear confidence score per sampled diff, 2) a way to pin examples for operator review.
Raj (eng-runtime): confidence score can be from model-diff heuristics (bleu-ish + embedding-sim). it's noisy; present as a band (low/med/high) not a single float.
Liu (eng-sre): defaults: sample 100% during soft-degrade for first 10 minutes, then 10% after stabilization. retain full traces for any operator action. Ops cost note: full-trace retention for 10m of every incident is heavy.
Anna (eng-platform): Zoe, can the decision card show retention tier (gold/silver/bronze) and allow a quick "archive trace" button?
Zoe (devex): yes. UI will show storage impact estimate inline.
Maya (product): simulation is key. SimBot, can you run 3 sims: noisy errors (spikes), slow tail (p99 up), and kernel OOM bursts? output cost delta and fp_rate.
SimBot: starting sim #1 (noisy errors): workload=50k reqs over 10m. trigger rule: err_rate>4% over 60s.
SimBot: sim #1 result: soft-degrade engagements=12, hard-degrade escalations=2, cost_delta=-14.2%, fp_rate=0.7%, avg_sampled_confidence=MED.
SimBot: starting sim #2 (p99 tail): workload=50k reqs, p99>1500ms rule.
SimBot: sim #2 result: soft_degrade=6, hard=0, cost_delta=-8.1%, latency_p99_improvement_on_fallback=-230ms, quality_loss_est=0.4%.
SimBot: starting sim #3 (OOM bursts): 20k reqs, kernel errors spike.
SimBot: sim #3 result: soft=20, hard=8, cost_delta=-21.5%, fp_rate=1.5%, operator_overrides_recommended=5.
Raj (eng-runtime): interesting. OOM bursts produce more hard transitions. we should require operator approval before hard-degrade for model groups with stateful caches.
Maya (product): agree. add a boolean in the policy: "manual_gate_for_hard": true. default on for enterprise orgs.
Anna (eng-platform): for console UX: show a compact timeline: soft windows (amber) and hard windows (red) with clickable decision cards. also include "served_as" accounting so owners can see their original consumption.
Liu (eng-sre): on quotas: we'll increment owner's route quota but tag the fallback route with served_as. that preserves billing while showing infra load. need a clear metric name: served_as_count.
Raj (eng-runtime): make sure rate-limits are respected on fallback routes; if fallback saturates, policy must fall through to degrade-to-error or queue. add backoff_counter in audit logs.
Zoe (devex): UX question: should the decision card surface sample diffs inline or link to a dedicated diff viewer? inline might be noisy.
Maya (product): link to diff viewer with 3 inline thumbnails. operators can expand.
Anna (eng-platform): oscillation guard: policy should enforce exponential backoff between successive hard-degrade attempts and require a cool-down of at least 5 minutes.
Raj (eng-runtime): implemented as backoff_counter + next_allowed_hard_ts. will include in audit log: {decision_id, backoff_counter, operator_override, reason_code}.
Liu (eng-sre): telemetry retention tiers proposal: gold=retain full traces 30d, silver=retain 7d, bronze=retain 24h. default sampling: soft-first-10m=100%->silver, triggered-hard or operator_override->gold. will calc costs.
Anna (eng-platform): Zoe, add a simulation button near the policy editor that runs a dry-run on historical traffic (last 24h) and shows expected engagements and sample examples.
Zoe (devex): will add. also adding a "sensitivity slider" so users can tune threshold +/- 50% and immediately see sim diffs.
Maya (product): final product ask: provide a small policy template list: conservative (manual gate, long hysteresis), default (auto soft->auto hard), aggressive (short windows, no manual gate).
Raj (eng-runtime): caution: aggressive hurts quality for some models. will add templated warnings in editor.
SimBot: quick follow-up: combined-sim (mix of p99 tail + intermittent errors) => cost_delta=-12.9%, fp_rate=0.95%, predicted_operator_actions=3.
Anna (eng-platform): good. next steps: (1) Raj PR schema + backoff logic, (2) Liu cost calc for retention tiers, (3) Zoe add sim + retention UI, (4) Maya finalize templates. I'll create JIRA tickets.
Maya (product): I'll draft template copy and tooltips.
Raj (eng-runtime): PR by EOD Fri.
Liu (eng-sre): cost calc by Tue.
Anna (eng-platform): thanks team. will circle back after the first beta run. :rocket:
